title: Single Source
description: Single Source is a state ability in the The Unified Singleton State database. Keeps exactly one authoritative copy of every fact. All reads go through the store; caches are invalidated on write. It takes facts and produces reads. Tunable parameters: 1 copy. Guarantee: two copies never disagree.

fields.mechanism: All reads go through the store; caches are invalidated on write.

demo.code:
var store={v:3};function get(k){return store[k];}
console.log('State value: '+get('v'));

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.

title: Atomic Writes
description: Atomic Writes is a state ability in the The Unified Singleton State database. Applies writes atomically — all or nothing. Writes batch into transactions; failures roll back completely. It takes writes and produces commits. Tunable parameters: transactional. Guarantee: partial writes never persist.

fields.mechanism: Writes batch into transactions; failures roll back completely.

title: Time Travel

It takes versions and produces past state. Tunable parameters: per write. Guarantee: time travel never loses the present.

title: Schema Enforcement
description: Schema Enforcement is a state ability in the The Unified Singleton State database. Enforces a schema on every write. Writes are validated; invalid writes are rejected with reasons. It takes schema and produces verdicts. Tunable parameters: per write. Guarantee: invalid state never persists.

title: Persistence
description: Persistence is a state ability in the The Unified Singleton State database. Persists the state to disk continuously. Writes append to a log; snapshots bound recovery time. It takes writes and produces disk. Tunable parameters: append log. Guarantee: committed writes are never lost.

fields.mechanism: Writes append to a log; snapshots bound recovery time.

title: Conflict-Free Merges
description: Conflict-Free Merges is a state ability in the The Unified Singleton State database. Merges concurrent edits without conflicts. CRDT rules merge by construction; no manual resolution is needed. It takes edits and produces merged. Tunable parameters: CRDT. Guarantee: merges never lose an edit.

fields.mechanism: CRDT rules merge by construction; no manual resolution is needed.

title: Access Scopes
description: Access Scopes is a state ability in the The Unified Singleton State database. Scopes reads and writes per caller. Each caller gets paths it may touch; out-of-scope access fails. It takes callers and produces scopes. Tunable parameters: per path. Guarantee: scopes are never widened silently.

fields.mechanism: Each caller gets paths it may touch; out-of-scope access fails.

title: State Snapshots
description: State Snapshots is a state ability in the The Unified Singleton State database. Snapshots the state for backup and transfer. Snapshots are versioned and checksummed; restores are exact. It takes state and produces snapshots. Tunable parameters: per version. Guarantee: snapshots always restore exactly.

fields.mechanism: Snapshots are versioned and checksummed; restores are exact.

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.

title: Migration Scripts
description: Migration Scripts is a state ability in the The Unified Singleton State database. Migrates state between schema versions safely. Migrations run in order with rollback; each is tested. It takes schemas and produces migrated. Tunable parameters: ordered. Guarantee: migrations never skip a version.

fields.mechanism: Migrations run in order with rollback; each is tested.
